index.title: Howdy!
index.content:
My name is Evan. I started this site as an effort to write more.
I have been using obsidian for the past year or so,
but have only ever used it to take personal notes. This site is an experiment
using it to capture more thoughts and publish them using a quartz
site.
I have the following goals for this project:

Capture things I learn by writting more
Interlink every page to create a digital garden of sorts
Get more comfortable with programming in general

Here is the mantra that started it all.

mantra.title: The Best Time to Plant a Tree
mantra.content:
The best time was 20 years ago. The second best time is today.
This is the mantra that inspired me to start this garden.
